messages.subject: Lusungu | Mining, Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Africa Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Lusungu,

Your leadership of Kestria Zambia and the firm's Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure work, including mining, power, oil and gas, renewables and community impact, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I work across ministries, regulators, communities and technical functions to convert external obligations into accountable execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in mining, energy and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Zambia, Southern Africa, wider Africa, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria Africa-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
